floater.name: xui_studio
floater.title: XUI Studio
floater.floater.string: No editor: set the ExternalEditor setting or the LL_XUI_EDITOR environment variable, with %s for the file and %L for the line.
The window would not give a snapshot.
This kind of file is catalogued and searched, not built.
[TAG] is a viewer widget: a shell build does not run its constructor. Catalogued and searched.
A [TAG] cannot be built from its template alone: it wants a model, a parent or children the template does not give it.
[VIEWS] views in [MS] ms, [DIAG] findings, [SKIN]/[LANG]; the registered floater, so no handles
Could not build [FILE]: see the findings.
Reloaded after a change on disk.
[FILE] in [LAYER], with edits not yet saved
[FILE] in [SKIN]/[LANG], being looked at and not held: the next file chosen takes its place
[FILE] is chosen and waits for the pin to come off; pressing here takes the pin off
The canvas is held on [FILE]; [PENDING] is built when the pin comes off.
The canvas is held on [FILE], which is the file the catalog is on.
Select an element to move it.
Select more than one element: shift-control-click on the canvas, or hold shift in the outline. The one the handles are on is the one the rest line up with.
Nothing to move: what is selected is already lined up, or a stack places it.
Took [ATTRS] out of [FILE] in [LAYER]; whatever was in force before it is in force again
Wrote [ATTRS] to [FILE] in [LAYER]; the preview's own frame is placed here, not by the file
Moved the preview on its canvas. Where it sits here is not in the file, so nothing was written.
The preview's own frame is placed here, not by the file: its size is editable, its position is not.
Put [FILE] back the way it was.
Wrote [FILE] and moved [MOVES] translations to where it now puts them.
[COUNT] translations of this element stop applying; Save and Repair Translations moves them.
Fixed [COUNT] findings in [FILE]; each one is its own edit to undo.
That is not written here any more.
That finding is about [FILE]; open it to fix it.
Put the files back to [COUNT] edits in.
[SHOWN] of [TOTAL] shown; [HELD] findings over [FILES] files checked
[ATTR], as each layer has it; writing puts the value in force into the chosen one.
No field chosen: click a gutter mark beside a row in Attributes.
Choose the layer to write it into.
No layer writes that field, so there is no value to override.
Every layer of this file, and what each says about [ATTR]; a dot marks the one the merge takes. Choose a layer and press Write here to give it the value in force.
A dot marks the layer whose value is in force
The skin and the language the layer belongs to, in the order they are merged
What this layer writes for [ATTR], or nothing where it does not write it
The line the element starts on in that layer
Write the value of [ATTR] that is in force into the chosen layer, so that layer has the last word about it
How many places the words were found, in how many files
The words to look for. Return runs the search; the results list where they were found, by file.
The root of the file: press to select it
Press to select [NAME]; the arrow offers the [COUNT] other elements beside it
a few letters of the file name
Which part of a file the words are looked for in
How the words are compared with what is in the file
Lint all: [FOUND] findings over [FILES] files; the report is [PATH]
No translation stops applying because of this.
[COUNT] translations stop applying if this is written as it stands: [LANGS]. Save and Repair Translations moves them.
Read [FILE] again; what was done to it is gone.
[FILE] changed on disk, and there are changes here that are not written. Save to keep these, or revert to take those.
[TRANSLATED] translated, [RESCUED] applied after a move, [MISSING] missing, [NOTAPPLIED] applying to nothing, [PLACEHOLDERS] stale, [FORBIDDEN] forbidden
Select a file and a language.
The language writes nothing for this row.
Moved [COUNT] values into place across [FILES] files in [LANG]
Took [COUNT] orphaned values out of [FILES] files in [LANG]
Nothing in [FILE] is written at a path the base has moved on from.
Choose a language other than the base to translate into.
Gave [FILES] files in [LANG] the base's root name; [LEFT] left alone as translations of something else
Counting what every language's overlay does...
[COVERED] values arrive, [NOTHING] apply to nothing; table written to [FILE]
Sent [NAME] through the channels; the Channels tab says where it went.
[WHAT] is cut; select where it goes and choose Move It Here.
Nothing is cut, or it is cut and this is where it already is.
[WHAT] now lives in [INTO], with its position written for where it landed.
A layout stack lays its panels out itself: drag the edge along the stack to change the one dimension it reads.
Wrote [ATTRS] to [FILE] in [LAYER]; [SIBLING] gives up the room
Choose an element in the outline, or control-click one on the canvas.
Every value it has is in force from somewhere else: the widget's own defaults, or a layer under this one.
The filter matches the names a file writes, dots and all. Clear it to see the rest.
Nobody writes this here. What is shown is what is in force, and changing it writes it for the first time.
[NAME] is read off every widget and thrown away. A file may write it; nothing does anything with it.
[NAME] is written here and declared by nothing. Either the name is a typo or the widget stopped answering to it.
[NAME] works, and nothing new should write it.
[NAME] works, and nothing new should write it: [INSTEAD] is the name to use.
Take [NAME] out of this file again, and let whatever was in force before it be in force.
Holds the gap between this element's left edge and its parent's, so the element stays where it is when the parent widens. Click to hold it or to let it go.
Holds the gap between this element's bottom edge and its parent's, so the element stays where it is when the parent grows taller. Click to hold it or to let it go.
Holds the gap between this element's right edge and its parent's, so the element travels with that edge when the parent widens. Click to hold it or to let it go.
Holds the gap between this element's top edge and its parent's, so the element travels with that edge when the parent grows taller. Click to hold it or to let it go.
Both side edges held at once, which is a width that has to give: the element grows and shrinks across with its parent. Click to hold both or to let both go.
Both the top and the bottom held at once, which is a height that has to give: the element grows and shrinks down with its parent. Click to hold both or to let both go.
This element does not name a file of its own.
[FILE] is named here but is not in the catalog.
there is no base file to translate
the base file is in no directory
the base file is in no language directory
applied where the base moved it
applies to nothing: no such field

menu_item_call.label: Open the File This Element Names
menu_item_call.name: open_nested

menu_item_check.label: Navigator in a Window of its Own
menu_item_check.name: out_navigator

menu_item_check.label: Inspectors in a Window of their Own
menu_item_check.name: out_inspectors

menu_item_check.label: Findings and Tables in a Window of their Own
menu_item_check.name: out_bottom

menu_item_check.label: Preview in a Window of its Own
menu_item_check.name: float_preview

combo_box.name: skin_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which skin the preview is built in. A skin's own copy of a file is layered over the default's, so what is on the canvas is what that skin's users see.

combo_box.name: language_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Which language the preview is built in. The language file is layered over the base one, so what is on the canvas is what a reader of that language sees.

button.label: Library
button.name: library_btn
button.tool_tip: Every tag a file may write, what the schema knows about each, and one of it built to look at (Control+Shift+L)

button.label: Edit
button.name: edit_btn
button.tool_tip: Open the selected element's file in the external editor at its line

button.label: Navigator
button.name: fold_navigator
button.tool_tip: The pane of files, the outline, search and the library, down the left (Control+0)

button.label: Tables
button.name: fold_bottom
button.tool_tip: The band under the canvas: findings, translation, notices and channels (Control+Shift+B)

button.label: Inspectors
button.name: fold_inspectors
button.tool_tip: The inspectors of the selected element, down the right (Control+Alt+0)

panel.label: Files
panel.name: files_mode
panel.tool_tip: Files: every XUI file in the skin, with the ones the chosen skin and language have of their own

scroll_list.name: file_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every XUI file the skins hold, and which of them have a copy of each. Choose one to build it on the canvas.

scroll_list.columns.label: L
scroll_list.columns.name: lang
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: The chosen language has a file

scroll_list.columns.label: S
scroll_list.columns.name: skin
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: The chosen skin has a file

filter_editor.label: Filter files
filter_editor.name: catalog_filter
filter_editor.tool_tip: Narrow the list to the files whose name carries this

panel.label: Outline
panel.name: outline_mode
panel.tool_tip: Outline: the tree of the previewed file, with its filter and the buttons that reorder it

jump_bar.name: breadcrumb
jump_bar.tool_tip: Where the selected element is, from the root of the file down. Press a step to select it; press its arrow to pick one of the elements beside it instead.

layout_panel.name: edit_target_row

text.name: edit_target
text.tool_tip: Ctrl-click an element in the preview to select it and Ctrl-drag to move it; the middle handle moves it and the corners and edges resize it; arrows move it a pixel and ten with shift; a plain click works the widget itself

layout_panel.text: Select an element to move it.

button.label: Up
button.name: tree_up
button.tool_tip: Move the element before the one above it (Control+Up)

button.label: Down
button.name: tree_down
button.tool_tip: Move the element after the one below it (Control+Down)

button.label: In
button.name: tree_in
button.tool_tip: Make it a child of the element above it (Control+Right)

button.label: Out
button.name: tree_out
button.tool_tip: Make it a sibling of its parent (Control+Left)

filter_editor.label: Filter by name or tag
filter_editor.name: tree_filter
filter_editor.tool_tip: Narrow the outline to the elements whose name, tag or value carries this

panel.label: Find
panel.name: find_mode
panel.tool_tip: Find: a search across every file and every layer

scope_bar.name: find_bar
scope_bar.tool_tip: A search said as a sentence: what kind of thing to look for, how the words have to match, the words, and which layers to look in. Return runs it, and changing a word runs it again.

scroll_list.name: find_results
scroll_list.tool_tip: Where the words were found, gathered by file. Choose a row to open that file and select the element it is in.

panel.label: Documents
panel.name: documents_mode
panel.tool_tip: Documents: every file this tool has open, and which of them have work the disk has not heard about

scroll_list.name: documents
scroll_list.tool_tip: Double-click to look at one; a dot means it has work the disk has not heard about

scroll_list.columns.label: Steps
scroll_list.columns.name: steps
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: how many edits are in it to put back

button.label: Save
button.name: document_save
button.tool_tip: Write this one

button.label: Revert
button.name: document_revert
button.tool_tip: Read it back off the disk, losing the work in it

button.label: Close
button.name: document_close
button.tool_tip: Let go of it; a document with work in it has to be saved or reverted first

button.label: Save All
button.name: document_save_all
button.tool_tip: Write every one that has work in it

panel.label: Library
panel.name: palette_mode
panel.tool_tip: Library: the tags the selected element may contain

specimen_list.empty_sentence: Choose an element in the outline; what it accepts is listed here, each as the widget itself.
specimen_list.name: palette
specimen_list.tool_tip: The tags the selected element may contain, each as the widget it builds

text.name: palette_note
text.tool_tip: What the chosen tag is for, in a sentence from xui_notes.xml; a tag nobody has written one for says nothing here

scroll_list.name: palette_attributes
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the chosen tag takes, and what it already carries: an attribute written as what it carries says nothing the widget does not say itself

button.label: Insert
button.name: palette_insert
button.tool_tip: Put one of these under the selected element, with a name and where it goes and nothing else

button.label: Shown
button.name: canvas_shown
button.tool_tip: Hide the preview and give the room to what is being read about it; what is on the canvas stays built

button.label: Pin
button.name: canvas_pinned
button.tool_tip: Hold the canvas on this file while the catalog is read; the file chosen meanwhile is taken when the pin comes off

tab_strip.name: canvas_tabs
tab_strip.tool_tip: The files this tool holds, one tab each; the tab shown is the file on the canvas, and a tab in the other face is only being looked at

button.label: Show
button.name: show_btn
button.tool_tip: Build the selected file again

button.label: Hide
button.name: hide_btn
button.tool_tip: Take what is on the canvas off it

button.label: Reload
button.name: reload_btn
button.tool_tip: Read the catalog and the file again from disk

spinner.name: canvas_zoom
spinner.tool_tip: How much bigger than life the preview is drawn, as a percentage; the numbers in it stay the file's own. Control and the wheel over the canvas moves it by the same step.

button.label: Rulers
button.name: canvas_rulers
button.tool_tip: A rule along the top and the left of the canvas, numbered in the file's own coordinates

button.label: Snap
button.name: canvas_snap
button.tool_tip: A drag lands on the grid rather than where the pointer is

combo_box.name: canvas_grid
combo_box.tool_tip: How far apart the grid is, and how far a snapped drag moves

check_box.label: Second
check_box.name: secondary_check
check_box.tool_tip: Build the file a second time in another language, on the canvas beside the first, sharing its selection

combo_box.name: language_combo_2
combo_box.tool_tip: The language the second canvas is built in, beside the first. Both are the same file and share one selection.

button.name: align_left
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the left edge of the one the handles are on

button.name: align_centre
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the middle of the one the handles are on, across

button.name: align_right
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the right edge of the one the handles are on

button.name: align_top
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the top of the one the handles are on

button.name: align_middle
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the middle of the one the handles are on, down

button.name: align_bottom
button.tool_tip: Line the rest of the selection up with the bottom of the one the handles are on

panel.label: Findings
panel.name: findings_mode
panel.tool_tip: What the parser, the factory, the layer merge and the rules found in this file

combo_box.name: finding_scope
combo_box.tool_tip: This file, or every file a Lint All has checked

combo_box.name: finding_rule
combo_box.tool_tip: Only the findings of one rule; each rule that found something is listed with how many

combo_box.name: finding_severity
combo_box.tool_tip: The least severe finding to show: errors alone, warnings and errors, or everything down to notes

check_box.label: Fixable
check_box.name: finding_fixable
check_box.tool_tip: Only the ones this tool offers to put right

filter_editor.label: Filter
filter_editor.name: finding_filter
filter_editor.tool_tip: A word in the message, the name at fault, the element or the file

scroll_list.name: findings
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the parser, the factory, the layer merge and the rules found; double-click selects the element

scroll_list.columns.name: severity
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: How bad it is: an error means the element does not work, a warning that it probably does not do what the file says, and a note is worth a look and often on purpose

scroll_list.columns.label: Fix
scroll_list.columns.name: fix
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: What this tool would do about it, where it knows

button.label: Fix
button.name: finding_fix
button.tool_tip: Do what the Fix column says, as one edit that can be undone

button.label: Fix All
button.name: finding_fix_all
button.tool_tip: Every finding in this file that offers one, each its own edit

text.name: finding_count
text.tool_tip: How many findings the list shows, of how many it could, and how many files a Lint All has read

panel.label: Translation
panel.name: translation_mode
panel.tool_tip: One row per field a translator writes, for the chosen language

combo_box.name: translate_language
combo_box.tool_tip: The language this table is about, which the second variant on the canvas shows

button.label: Repair file
button.name: translate_repair_file
button.tool_tip: Move every value this file writes at a path the base has moved on from, and change nothing else

button.label: Repair language
button.name: translate_repair_all
button.tool_tip: The same over every file this language has

button.label: Repair roots
button.name: translate_repair_roots
button.tool_tip: Give back the base's root name to the files of this language that carry another, or none: the root is what a whole file is matched on

button.label: Remove orphans
button.name: translate_remove_orphans
button.tool_tip: Take out of every file of this language each value written for something the base no longer has: an element of a lost name, an element with no name, an attribute the base's element does not carry. What the base has moved is left for Repair, and what it has at more than one path is left for you.

text.name: translate_counts
text.tool_tip: The rows by what state they are in: translated, missing from the language, written at a path the base has moved on from, translated but with different placeholders, or marked not to be translated

scroll_list.name: translate_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: One row per field a translator writes; double-click selects the element

scroll_list.columns.label: State
scroll_list.columns.name: state
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Whether the language has this value, is missing it, or writes it at a path the base has moved on from

scroll_list.columns.label: Fits
scroll_list.columns.name: fits
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Whether the translation fits its widget in the second variant

text_editor.label: Select a row above to translate it
text_editor.name: translate_value
text_editor.tool_tip: The translation for the selected row. A translation may run to several lines, so return puts one in; the button beside it writes.

button.label: Write
button.name: translate_write
button.tool_tip: Write it where the merge will find it, under the ancestors the base gives it

button.label: Remove
button.name: translate_remove
button.tool_tip: Take the language's value for this row out of its file: the attribute, or the element where its text was all it carried. The way a value that names nothing the base has leaves the file.

panel.label: Notices
panel.name: notifications_mode
panel.tool_tip: Every template notifications.xml declares, and the panel each would produce

scroll_list.name: notifications
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every template notifications.xml declares; select one to build the panel it would produce

filter_editor.label: Filter
filter_editor.name: notification_filter
filter_editor.tool_tip: Narrow the list to the templates whose name carries this

button.label: Post
button.name: notification_post
button.tool_tip: Send the selected notification for real, through the channels, as the viewer would

panel.label: History
panel.name: history_mode
panel.tool_tip: Everything done to the files this tool has open, with a mark where the present is

history_list.empty_sentence: Edits show up here as you make them, newest first. Double-click one to put the files back the way they were just after it.
history_list.name: history
history_list.tool_tip: Everything done to the open files, newest first, with a mark on the present. Click a step to see the element it was about; double-click one to put the files back the way they were just after it.

panel.label: Channels
panel.name: channels_mode
panel.tool_tip: What the notification system did with what was posted

combo_box.name: channel_response
combo_box.tool_tip: The buttons the selected notification's form declares

button.label: Respond
button.name: channel_respond
button.tool_tip: Answer the notification as a user would, which is a real answer

button.label: Clear
button.name: channel_clear
button.tool_tip: Empty the list; what has already been through the channels stays through them

scroll_list.name: channels
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every notification through every channel since this floater opened, in the order the channels process them

panel.label: Attributes
panel.name: attributes_tab
panel.tool_tip: Attributes: every field the tag answers to, with what is in force and who wrote it

text.name: attributes_what
text.tool_tip: The selected element: its name, its tag as the file writes it, and the class the viewer built for it

filter_editor.label: Filter fields
filter_editor.name: attributes_filter
filter_editor.tool_tip: Narrow the rows to the fields whose name carries this

check_box.label: Only what the files write
check_box.name: attributes_authored
check_box.tool_tip: The short list an author is working in: the fields this file actually writes

check_box.label: Nested fields
check_box.name: attributes_nested
check_box.tool_tip: The leaves of the blocks a field carries, such as font.name and bg_alpha_color.alpha. A nested field the file writes is always shown.

panel.label: Layout
panel.name: layout_tab
panel.tool_tip: Layout: where the element ended up, and which of its numbers decided that

scroll_list.name: layout
scroll_list.tool_tip: What decides where this element is: its own numbers, the numbers the file writes, and what its parent does with them.

panel.label: Source
panel.name: source_tab
panel.tool_tip: Source: the element as each layer writes it, one after another

text.name: source_layers
text.tool_tip: Every layer of this file, with the line the selected element starts on in each, in the order they are merged; a dash where the layer does not carry it

button.label: Open in editor
button.name: jump_btn
button.tool_tip: Open the file in the external editor, at this element's line

scroll_list.name: source_layer_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every layer of this file: what each says about the chosen field, and which one the merge takes

scroll_list.columns.name: force
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: a dot marks the one in force

button.label: Write here
button.name: write_override
button.tool_tip: Write the value in force into the chosen layer, so that layer overrides the rest

text.name: override_field
text.tool_tip: The field the list below is about, and what Write here writes: the value in force, into the layer chosen there

text_editor.name: source_text
text_editor.tool_tip: The element as each layer of the file writes it, in the order they are merged

panel.label: Bindings
panel.name: bindings_tab
panel.tool_tip: Bindings: the callbacks the file names, and whether anything answers to them

scroll_list.name: bindings
scroll_list.tool_tip: The callbacks the file names, and whether anything is registered to answer to each name.

panel.label: State
panel.name: state_tab
panel.tool_tip: State: what the built widget says about itself right now

scroll_list.name: state
scroll_list.tool_tip: What the built widget says about itself as it is now, read again while this tab is showing.

panel.label: Findings
panel.name: findings_tab
panel.tool_tip: Findings: what the parser, the merge and the rules said about this element

scroll_list.name: selection_findings
scroll_list.tool_tip: The findings on the selected element and everything below it
